title: Sign in with Google
description: Let staff and teachers sign in with the school's Google Workspace account, in addition to a username and password.
statusBody: While on, a "Sign in with Google" button appears on the login page for this school.
neverConfigured: Never configured yet. Fill in the client id, client secret, and Google Workspace domain below to enable it.
clientSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the currently stored client secret.
hostedDomainHint: Only Google accounts on this domain can be used to sign in.
removeDialogBody: The "Sign in with Google" button disappears from the login page until this is set up again.
validationRequired: Client ID and Google Workspace domain are required
